scope: Prospective authored-task pilot: textual primitive Core v8 assembly versus the disclosed safe Rust profile; not population productivity.
task_order: listed; HIA then Rust on even task indices, reversed on odd indices
formal_hidden_materialization: Only after this protocol, source, controls and independent review are remotely committed. Development controls use a distinct seed/case set.
transport: One bounded local codex app-server process and ephemeral thread per cell; persistent thread history across at most six explicit turn/start calls. Only actual public RPC feedback is appended. No complete-history rewrapping, context compaction, resume, hidden feedback, or turn retry.
catalog_policy: Complete selected v8 opcode catalog, textual grammar, task interfaces and restrictions are included at the first turn; catalog remains available. Rust receives its complete selected API and source-profile description at the first turn. Same tools, check quota, output contract and diagnostics policy.
token_policy: Persist each raw cumulative and last/delta usage event separately. Validate monotonic totals, compare per-turn deltas and the final cumulative total without double counting. Record input, cached input, cache-write input, output, reasoning output and provider total separately. Do not assume whether reasoning is included in output, do not call a conservative sum a bill, and keep absent counts unknown. Observed token limits are post-generation checks, not promised provider-side hard limits.
public_feedback: Actual syntax/Core/type/compiler diagnostics and disclosed public native cases. Source and artifact hashes bind every accepted candidate. Only model-generated revisions count as repairs.
hidden_policy: One terminal native evaluation of frozen-seed future cases after final public acceptance; never insert hidden cases, outputs, oracle code or pass/fail into the thread. Model process is closed before hidden evaluation.
provider_limits: CLI version and effective reported model/provider/sandbox/effort are retained. Provider weights, routing, sampling and prompt-cache state cannot be independently attested; no claim of cache/scheduling control.
advantage_gate: Descriptive only: complete 12 cells, complete required provider usage with cumulative/last agreement, no observed direct-tool contamination and stable identities; no fewer HIA successes, strictly lower provider-reported totalTokens and end-to-end cell wall, and no more failed public checks. Optional cacheWriteInputTokens may remain unknown; no billing/cache-control/population/human-cost advantage claim.
no_rerun: Every attempted cell, protocol failure, unknown usage and timeout retained. Infrastructure failure stops the campaign; no fallback transport/model or post-result tuning.
tool_restriction_evidence: The bound CLI advertises all named switches. Actual zero-generation features-list control returned false for 11 switches but unified_exec remained true despite --disable. This failed all-disabled assertion is preserved; no managed configuration is modified. Both arms use identical requested restrictions, empty environments and read-only sandbox. web_search=disabled is a supported local schema enum. These settings do not prove a hermetic environment or disable every MCP/internal access. A startup features-list receipt must match registered effective values. Complete raw telemetry after process closure is mandatory: any server request or direct-tool item, including queued tail after turn/completed, contaminates and fails the entire cell before hidden evaluation. Existing hooks/user instructions remain enabled.
usage_eligibility: Required provider usage categories are inputTokens, cachedInputTokens, outputTokens, reasoningOutputTokens and totalTokens, all exact nonnegative integers. Per-turn provider last must match cumulative delta; mismatch terminates the cell as ineligible for single-explicit-turn comparison. Missing optional cacheWriteInputTokens stays null. Complete required usage permits descriptive provider-total comparisons; all-raw-categories-known is separate. Billing, provider-cache control and human-cost claims remain false. Final raw-stream cumulative usage must also equal the completed-turn accounting. A queued tail mismatch preserves the observed counters but makes comparative usage unknown/ineligible; an observed token-cap breach stops the cell before hidden evaluation.
resource_witness_scope: Selected HIA buffer.store/load/owner and loan VM events plus actual native value agreement; selected Rust indexed audited-Vec API with real Vec storage plus actual native value agreement. These are not backend refinement, whole-process allocator accounting or machine-store proofs. Conditional release requires one allocation/release on every input including odd-y, without claiming an invisible branch was evaluated after allocation.

native_execution_limits.limit_receipt: actual getrlimit after application, PID and exact binary path before exec; parent checks receipt and binary identity
native_execution_limits.scope: RLIMIT_AS is virtual address space, not peak RSS, formal allocator safety or complete OS isolation

development_tools: Unit tests may explicitly pass discovered RUSTC/CLANG absolute paths only to non-formal evaluations; overrides are recorded. Author controls and all formal campaign public/terminal evaluations use frozen PROTOCOL tool pins. Missing CI tools fail instead of silently skipping.
budget_accounting: The terminal evaluator retains the same 10-second cleanup reserve. Final campaign wall is checked again after final identity verification; actual excess makes the campaign incomplete, never a pass. The last result-file serialization is outside its own recorded timestamp.
